title: 조기진급 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Exclusion, Challenge and Recusal of Committee Members)
(1) A member of the Committee (hereinafter referred to as a "member") who is, or was, a relative of a student subject to evaluation under any subparagraph of Article 5 (1) shall be excluded from the Committee's evaluation.
(2) Where circumstances make it difficult to expect a fair evaluation from a member, the student subject to evaluation under any subparagraph of Article 5 (1), or the student's parent, may apply to the Committee to challenge that member, and the Committee shall determine the challenge by resolution. In such cases, the member challenged shall not participate in the resolution.
(3) A member who falls under grounds for exclusion pursuant to paragraph (1) shall voluntarily recuse himself or herself from the Committee's evaluation.
